documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported revenue from operations of INR 347 crores for Q1 FY27, achieving a 27% year-over-year growth along with EBITDA growth of 55% to INR 90 crores and PAT growth of 64% to INR 57 crores. Construction equipment segment performance was strong, accounting for 45% of total Q1 FY27 revenue, driven by infrastructure investments and new order wins. Management highlighted that large agricultural equipment demand remains at cyclical bottoms but expects recovery starting in calendar year 2027, while small agricultural demand in India continues to perform well. The balance sheet maintained a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores at the end of the quarter. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR 3,552 million, revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%.

guidance.claim: Q2 FY27 performance is expected to be robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Revenue from Mexico warehouse operations is expected to be at a mid-single-digit million dollar level in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of comfortably delivering over 20% EBITDA margin for FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects revenue growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins comfortably above 20% as volumes build in FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth momentum in the construction equipment segment from H2 CY25 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Conditions in large agricultural equipment remain subdued, with CY26 expected to represent the cyclical bottom prior to recovery in CY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: India small agricultural equipment market continues to perform well due to government subsidies and higher adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction equipment segment accounted for 45% of the company's total revenue in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket business contributed about 12% of total revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is supporting customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Unit volumes in small agriculture are starting to show signs of recovery following three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 is the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery anticipated through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused aftermarket customers and channel partners to temporarily moderate purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to strengthen in FY27, with H2 being stronger than H1.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: European compact construction equipment demand has been a bright spot with early signs of recovery visible in Q4 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, the demand for compact equipment has been a bright spot and infrastructure-led spending supported by fiscal stimulus defense investment and energy transition projects is expected to provide a more stable demand environment throughout the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Large tractor industry volumes in North America continue to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule with uninterrupted customer supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating about half a dozen acquisition opportunities in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications.
capex_expansion.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: The company continues to invest in growing its construction and large agricultural equipment businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are continuing to invest in growing our construction and large agricultural equipment businesses, given that small ag is already a segment where we hold significant global market share.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts maintains its capex plan at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR12 crores for Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Efforts are underway to rebuild the Ludhiana facility finishing shop to bring it online by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 90 crores, representing 55% year-on-year and 10% sequential growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs stood at 33.3% in Q1 FY27, primarily driven by a change in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that normal material costs for the business range between 34% and 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts achieved Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27%, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Turning to Q1 FY27 performance we are pleased to report revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on- year and a PAT growth of 64% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: The West Asia situation has exerted pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost in Q4 FY26 returned to 35%, aligning with the company's normal range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: Now when we look at quarter 4 and let's understand the results of quarter 4, our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: The new wage code introduced in November 2025 had an impact of INR3.4 crores on FY26 profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores in annualized potential as of March 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The warehousing delivery channel accounted for about 51% of full-year FY26 sales.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. So, I think if you look at the full year sales for FY26, the warehousing channel has given us about 51% of sales.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash balance at the end of Q1 FY27 stood at approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stood at 139 days of trailing 12-month revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated INR 44 crores in operating cash during Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company distributed a special dividend of INR 101 crores in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reported a net cash position of INR 190 crore at the end of Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Management continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities to advance strategic plans.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remains net debt-free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, including an INR101 crore special dividend declared in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated stood at INR52 crores in Q4 FY26 and INR174 crores for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash flow was INR52 crores in Q4 and INR174 crores in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has put pressure on supply chains and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price volatility driven by tariffs caused demand skewing and moderated purchasing in the aftermarket.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic uncertainty and volatility have tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry conditions in the large agriculture segment remain subdued.
risks_headwinds.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the Ludhiana facility finishing shop towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fresh geopolitical escalations in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty and higher input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse facility are expected in Q3 of this fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to scale up into a meaningful business segment over the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26 growth.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects Q1 FY27 performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

management_commitments.claim: The North American small agriculture segment is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
